hypothesis: An exact one-pass relative-bias conversion can reduce redundant indexing/memory passes in the native safe SM103 attention fallback and improve complete forward latency.
source_inspection_scope: Single-token decode selects native rel_decode_attention and may make zero unshear calls. Such cases remain full-model exact-correctness and regression controls; no helper latency or captured helper input is invented for an uncalled path.
unchanged: model weights and native mixed quantization

matrix.decode_history_length: L cached tokens, one timed token; total L+1

resident_policy: One loaded engine across every compatible case/variant in each batch. Separate plain and Nsight processes require one startup each; no instrumented timings called unattached. One sequential 2xB300 allocation; no concurrent benchmarks.
baseline_and_correctness: Native history preparation and a single native reference per case are retained across variant switches. Restore exact attention/convolution state before each invocation. Require byte-exact helper outputs on actual captured and adversarial inputs and byte-exact full-model logits against native; a mismatch blocks candidate performance claims.
adversarial_requirements: ragged multiple requests and zero-length requests
positive and negative infinity to dtype finite limits
CUDA graph replay with in-place changed device sequence metadata

timing.order: Alternate native/fused order per pair; reverse first order in block2
timing.two_rank_metric: Maximum synchronized rank-local wall duration, never rank sum
timing.compilation: Preserve all observations; if compilation/autotuning occurs during a block, warm up and repeat the entire ten-pair block with bounded retries. Never selectively remove slow samples.

profiling.attribution: Helper NVTX CPU ranges plus process/thread-aware CUDA launch correlation to actual kernels; an asynchronous CPU NVTX span is not helper GPU latency
profiling.counts: Record native helper invocations and their kernel counts per rank/case; do not infer ownership from generic kernel names

memory: Report PyTorch allocator allocated/reserved/incremental peaks and captured-input snapshot cost separately. Native KV VMM physical commitment is outside Torch allocator scope; do not claim an exact all-allocator peak.

decision.eager_winner: All correctness gates pass; primary mean improves in both confirmation blocks; pooled paired bootstrap95% interval for baseline/candidate mean-latency ratio exceeds1; mean decode latency does not increase at any tested history length
decision.not_adopted_until: Winning candidate is additionally checked under existing native CUDA-graph serving configuration, using separate comparable measurements
decision.interpretation: A helper-only speedup or Amdahl counterfactual is not a measured full-forward or serving gain. Any failed or inconclusive gate is retained and reported.

artifacts: actual runtime inventory and selected nonsecret environment
bounded representative actual helper tensor inputs with hashes
every warmup and measured observation including rejected attempts
Nsight raw reports and SQLite exports
read-only derived analysis and archive verification
limits: One pretrained inference model; inference only
Native sequence parallelism activates at2048 query tokens
No new hardware-utilization or HBM-bandwidth claims without measured counters
Synthetic tokens do not characterize production chat workloads
